en.name: Fermented black beans
en.summary: These are whole soybeans fermented, salted and part-dried — the loose, wrinkled, intensely savoury beans sold in bags and tubs, not the jarred sauce. An airtight jar in a cool dark cupboard keeps them about 12–24 months. In a humid climate the fridge or freezer is the safer cupboard, though no agency publishes a cold-storage figure.
en.pantry: Dry fermented black beans need only an airtight jar in a cool dark cupboard, about 12–24 months from purchase — a range borrowed from dried beans, adjusted for the fact that these carry far more salt and a little more moisture. Salt and low water activity are preservation barriers in their own right, which is why they are stable without cold. Do not rinse the beans before storing, only before cooking, and never put a damp spoon in the jar.
en.fridge: In a humid climate the fridge is the safer cupboard: it stops the beans absorbing moisture from the air, going tacky and then mouldy, and it keeps pantry moths out. No agency publishes a cold-storage figure for fermented black beans, so none is given here — the point of refrigerating them is dryness, not a longer clock. Keep them in a genuinely airtight jar so condensation cannot get in when you take the jar out. Softer wet-packed beans in oil or brine are a different product: refrigerate those after opening and follow the jar.
en.freezer: The freezer works for the same reason the fridge does — it keeps the beans dry and keeps insects out — and no timeline is published for it either. Use a properly airtight container and take out what you need quickly rather than leaving the jar open on the counter, because condensation is the one thing that will spoil a dry salted bean. The beans do not freeze into a block, so you can spoon them straight from frozen.
en.thawing: None needed. Spoon out what you want and use it straight away; these beans stay loose at freezer temperature.
spoilage: Beans gone tacky, clumped or damp instead of loose and dry
Fuzzy mould on the surface of the beans or inside the lid
A rancid or musty smell rather than a deep, salty, savoury one
Insects, larvae or webbing in the jar
tips: Transfer bagged beans into a proper airtight jar the day you buy them.
Use a dry spoon and close the jar immediately.
Rinse only the portion you are about to cook, never the whole jar.
Chop the beans rather than rinsing the salt away if you want more flavour and less saltiness.

faq.q: How long do fermented black beans last?
faq.a: About 12–24 months in an airtight jar in a cool dark cupboard. That range is borrowed from dried beans; no agency publishes one for douchi.

faq.q: Should fermented black beans be refrigerated?
faq.a: They do not need to be, but in a humid climate the fridge or freezer keeps them dry and keeps moths out. No cold-storage figure is published.

faq.q: Do you rinse fermented black beans before cooking?
faq.a: Rinse only what you are about to use, and only if you want them less salty. Never rinse the whole jar and store them wet.

faq.q: Are these the same as black bean sauce?
faq.a: No. This is the dry salted bean. Black bean sauce is a jarred sauce made from them and keeps to its own timeline.

zh.name: 豆豉
zh.summary: 豆豉是整顆黃豆經過發酵、鹽漬、部分乾燥而成，就是那種一顆顆皺皺的、味道極濃的散裝豆，而不是罐裝的豆豉醬。裝進密封罐放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃，大約 12～24 個月。在潮濕的氣候裡，冰箱或冷凍庫才是更安全的「櫥櫃」，不過沒有機構公布低溫保存的期限。
zh.pantry: 乾豆豉只需要一個密封罐和陰涼避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 12～24 個月——這個範圍借自乾燥豆類，並考量豆豉鹽分高得多、水分也略多一些而做調整。鹽和低水活性本身就是保存屏障，這就是它不需要冷藏也很穩定的原因。存放前不要洗，要煮之前才洗，也絕對不要把沾濕的湯匙伸進罐子。
zh.fridge: 在潮濕的氣候裡，冰箱是更安全的櫥櫃：它能防止豆豉吸收空氣中的水分而變黏、進而發霉，也能擋掉米蟲和穀蛾。沒有機構為豆豉公布低溫保存期限，所以這裡也不給——冷藏的意義在於保持乾燥，而不是換來更長的時鐘。請用真正密封的罐子，這樣把罐子拿出來時冷凝水才進不去。至於泡在油或鹽水裡的濕豆豉，那是不同的產品：開封後冷藏，並依罐上指示使用。
zh.freezer: 冷凍有效的理由和冷藏一樣——保持乾燥、隔絕蟲害——而它同樣沒有已發表的期限。請用確實密封的容器，並且快速取用，不要把罐子開著放在檯面上，因為冷凝水是唯一真正會毀掉乾鹽漬豆的東西。豆豉不會凍成一整塊，可以直接從冷凍挖出來用。
zh.thawing: 不需要解凍。要用多少挖多少，直接下鍋；豆豉在冷凍溫度下仍然是散的。
spoilage: 豆子變黏、結塊或摸起來潮濕，而不是鬆散乾爽
豆子表面或蓋子內側長出毛狀的霉
聞起來有油耗味或霉味，而不是深沉的鹹香
tips: 袋裝的買回來當天就換進真正密封的罐子。
用乾燥的湯匙，取完立刻蓋緊。
只沖洗要下鍋的那一份，絕對不要整罐沖過。
想要香氣多、鹹度低，把豆豉剁碎比沖掉鹽分更有效。

faq.a: 密封罐放陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 12～24 個月。這個範圍借自乾燥豆類，豆豉本身沒有機構公布的數字。
不一定要，但在潮濕的氣候裡，冰箱或冷凍庫能讓它保持乾燥、也防蟲。低溫保存沒有已發表的期限。
只洗要用的那一份，而且只在你想減鹹時才洗。不要整罐洗過再濕著存放。
不一樣。這裡講的是乾的鹽漬豆；豆豉醬是用它做成的罐裝醬料，有自己的保存期限。
